theorems.name: Submission.bf_coneMass_subspace_ball_packing
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ (ι : Type) (T : Set ι) (w : ι → Rn N) (ρ : ι → ℝ) (w₀ : Rn N) (R : ℝ), T.Countable → (∀ i ∈ T, w i ∈ W) → w₀ ∈ W → (∀ i ∈ T, 0 < ρ i) → T.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ Metric.ball (w i) (ρ i)) → (∀ i ∈ T, Metric.ball (w i) (ρ i) ⊆ Metric.ball w₀ R) → ∑' i : T, ENNReal.ofReal (ρ i ^ n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
